summary: Tested (1) NEW push notifications backend feature (register-push endpoint + send_push() wired into chat/booking) and (2) first-time E2E verification of 3 previously-untested features (Course Bulk Import, Quizzes, Apple Sign-In). Wrote new /app/backend/tests/test_push_notifications.py (8 tests, all passing) confirming: register-push validates input (422 on missing/invalid fields) and never crashes the server even with the placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY (returns clean 500 JSON, not a raw crash); chat send_message, booking create/confirm/reminder-sweep all succeed normally (201/200) despite the push relay failing in the background - backend logs confirm 'push failed (non-blocking)' WARNING logs, never propagated as errors. Re-ran pre-existing test_course_import.py (14/14 passed), test_quizzes.py (11/11 passed incl. AI generation), test_apple_auth.py (7/7 passed) - all pass cleanly when EXPO_BACKEND_URL/EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is set correctly (confirms the previous session's env-setup note, not a functional issue). Frontend: full manual Playwright walkthrough of ALL flows as coach (jcgfit@gmail.com) and client (ilovejeremygillespie@gmail.com) - login screen loads cleanly, push registration fails silently on web (console shows expected 'not yet fully supported on web' message, no crash), Apple Sign-In button correctly does not render on web (iOS-only check, by design) with no crash. Course Bulk Import: uploaded a real .txt file via file-chooser, AI (claude-sonnet) correctly generated a course title/subtitle/module/lesson plan from the file content, edited fields in review screen, tapped 'Create Course' -> course created with correct module/lesson structure. Quizzes: built a multiple-choice question manually in the coach quiz builder, saved it, then as the client took the quiz and submitted the correct answer, got graded 100% correctly with correct-answer highlighting. Cleaned up all test-created data (deleted the test course; enrolled test client for the quiz test is now just an extra enrollment, harmless).

Optional/low priority: consider reseeding coach jcgfit's booking slug back to 'jcg-test' (currently 'pytest-booking' from an earlier test run) or updating test_credentials.md to reflect the current live slug, so future testing agents don't have to auto-discover it.

Flagging for a future native-device testing pass once a real push key is configured.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_push.py: send_push() and register_push() both correctly map upstream 401 -> 500 ('key missing/invalid') and upstream 5xx -> 502, keeping error semantics clean; every call site (routes_chat.py, routes_booking.py x3) wraps send_push() in try/except and only logger.warning()s on failure — exactly matches the 'never block the caller' requirement, verified empirically via backend logs showing consistent non-blocking WARNING lines for all 4 integration points.

src/lib/push.ts registerForPush() early-returns on Platform.OS === 'web' before touching any expo-notifications push-token API — correct given those APIs are unsupported on web; console log confirms 'not yet fully supported on web' rather than a thrown error.

login.tsx: Apple button is gated behind `appleAvailable` state which is only ever set true inside a Platform.OS === 'ios' check — on web it silently stays false and the button never renders, which is correct/expected but means the 'renders without crashing' requirement is trivially satisfied by never rendering at all on web (worth noting so this isn't mistaken for a bug).

routes_course_import.py _process_one_file() and _build_plan() are both defensively wrapped (never raise on a single bad file / LLM failure), matching the 'one bad file can't sink the batch' and 'nothing silently created' design goals — confirmed by walking the full UI flow with a real file.

routes_quizzes.py grading (_grade) is fully deterministic/local (no AI in scoring path) as documented, and get_quiz_to_take() strips correct_index/correct_text/explanation from the client-facing payload — verified the client UI never receives answer keys before submission.

success_rate.backend: 8/8 new push tests passed; 14/14 course-import, 11/11 quizzes, 7/7 apple-auth pre-existing tests passed (100% on all re-run suites)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — login/app-load, push-silent-on-web, Apple-button-hidden-on-web, course bulk import (upload->AI plan->create course), and quiz (build->take->submit->grade) all verified working via manual Playwright walkthrough
